scenarios.name: DRILL_ASYMMETRIC_PITOT_FREEZE
scenarios.description: Simulates ice accretion causing stagnation pressure loss in Pitot Probe 1 while probes 2 and 3 remain clear.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Probe 1 isolated by FDI within 200 ms; triplex MVS seamlessly falls back to duplex cross-check; normal law retained.

scenarios.name: DRILL_CCDL_INTER_LANE_DESYNC
scenarios.description: Injects a 25 ms transmission delay on Cross-Channel Data Link between Lane B and Lane C.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Lane B flagged as desynchronized; voter proceeds with healthy Lanes A and C.

scenarios.name: DRILL_STUCK_INBOARD_ELEVATOR
scenarios.description: Simulates mechanical seizure of the left inboard elevator actuator at 4 degrees trailing edge down.
scenarios.expected_outcome: OFD and rate deviation trip after 60 ms; control allocation transfers pitch authority to outboard elevators and auto-trims THS.

scenarios.name: DRILL_HIGH_SPEED_DIVE_EXCEEDANCE
scenarios.description: Aircraft forced into steep dive approaching VMO + 15 knots to trigger high-speed envelope protection.
scenarios.expected_outcome: High-speed protection commands positive pitch-up override, freezes nose-down trim, and limits dive velocity to VMO boundary.

scenarios.name: DRILL_EXTREME_WAKE_VORTEX
scenarios.description: Subject aircraft encounters severe wake vortex turbulence demanding sudden 3.4g load factor and 45 deg/sec roll rate.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Structural g-limiter clamps normal acceleration to +2.5g and roll rate limiter preserves wing root structural margin.

scenarios.name: DRILL_AFDX_NETWORK_A_SEVERANCE
scenarios.description: Simulates complete loss of AFDX Network A physical switch plane.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Redundancy management accepts 100% of packets via Network B; zero frame loss and zero command dropout observed at actuators.

scenarios.name: DRILL_DUAL_HYDRAULIC_LOSS
scenarios.description: Simulates failure of Green and Yellow hydraulic circuits, leaving Blue circuit operational.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Flight control law degrades gracefully to Alternate Law with roll control via remaining aileron pair and pitch via THS.

scenarios.name: DRILL_RUNAWAY_STABILIZER_OVERRIDE
scenarios.description: Simulates uncommanded Trimmable Horizontal Stabilizer (THS) pitch-trim screwjack motion.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Stick input in opposite direction immediately cuts electrical clutch to THS motor; pilot maintains pitch authority via elevators.
